literal: On one side is painful love; carrying pole like, on both sides it is sweet.
translation: Love is painful when it is one-sided. Like a carrying-pole, it is sweet only when balanced on both sides.
modern: காமம் ஒரு பக்கமாக மட்டும் இருந்தால் துன்பம் தரும். சுமை தூக்கும் காவடித் தடியைப் போல, அது இரு பக்கமும் சமமாக இருந்தால் மட்டுமே இன்பம் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts one-sided love with mutual love using a vivid everyday image. The word 'kā' refers to a pole carried on the shoulder with weights suspended from both ends. Just as the pole is painful to carry if the weight is only on one side, love brings anguish when felt by only one person. It becomes sweet and bearable only when the feeling is mutual, balancing the burden on both sides.
